digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and capability gating
propositions: T1, a blocking plan-review criterion, lost web-search grounding when production cut over to Bedrock because the provider-name prefix check resolved to 'bedrock:' instead of 'anthropic'
the web-access decision was gated by provider-name prefix shape rather than capability registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule against prefix matching
web-search tool was silently withheld with no signal in provenance, making the degradation undetectable in signed verdicts
Bedrock's Converse API does not carry Anthropic's native server-side web_search tool, so T1 must use a rebar-side search fallback mechanism instead
the fix moves web-access gating from anthropic_model.py's prefix check to capabilities.py with no model/provider argument, deriving the decision from model profile registry membership
